title: Nonnegativity of an expected-time bound
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, let $r\colon\{0,1\}^*\to\mathrm{Option}(\alpha)$, and let $B\in\mathbb{Q}$. If, for every natural number $K$, the sum over $0\le t<K$ of the probability that $r$ has not halted after $t$ random bits is at most $B$, then $B\ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $K\in\mathbb{N}$, the sum of nonhalting probabilities over $0\le t<K$ is at most $B$
